subject: Request: Short-lived residency exemption for log snapshot (FinHealth payment triage)
messages:
From: Samuel Nguyen <samuel.nguyen@finhealth.com>
To: support@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Payment latency incident - requesting recent logs

Hi team,

We saw a spike in payment processing latency between 03:15–03:45 UTC this morning that correlates with ~2% failed authorizations. Our engineers captured a small log archive but some of the traces look truncated — we suspect Redwood's rolling retention may have removed older KV-cache traces we need to correlate.

Can you:
- Confirm whether Redwood can provide a timeboxed snapshot (logs + KV cache metadata) covering 02:50–04:00 UTC for our tenant?
- Hold those artifacts for at least 72 hours while we triage (if possible) and grant our SREs temporary access?

I've attached the partial dump we pulled. We can jump on a call if helpful. FinHealth is in pilot for the payments flow and this issue is blocking our end-to-end smoke tests.

Attachments: error_dump_20271017.tar.gz (log archive, ~12MB)

Thanks,
Samuel Nguyen
Lead SRE, FinHealth
security@finhealth.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: samuel.nguyen@finhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment latency incident - requesting recent logs

Team,

FYI — FinHealth reported a production payment latency spike this morning and believes some relevant traces were removed by normal retention. They attached a partial log bundle. They need a short-lived snapshot (approx 02:50–04:00 UTC) preserved and temporary access for their SREs.

Request: Can Security + Eng approve a timeboxed residency/retention exception (48–72h) scoped to the FinHealth tenant and limited artifact types (logs, KV-cache metadata)? We should tighten scope to minimal shards and require an auditable access role.

Ticket: INF-4821 (linked).
Next steps I propose:
- Irene: confirm minimal acceptable scope & controls
- Markus: outline how we'll produce a snapshot (S3 object, encryption, scrub plan)
- Monica/Jordan: I'll coordinate FinHealth expectations and access window

Thanks — need a quick turnaround if possible. FinHealth is on a pilot path and this is high priority.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: samuel.nguyen@finhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-17T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment latency incident - requesting recent logs

Hi —

We can consider a short, narrowly-scoped residency exemption but need the following before approval:
1) Precise artifact list (logs, KV-cache keys, traces) and exact selectors (tenant id, time window, instance ids).
2) Justification for why standard retention couldn't satisfy the request (e.g., TTL expired, rotation gap).
3) Minimum access model — requestor principal names and whether they already have a Redwood account.
4) Timebox: propose 48 hours default; any extension must be escalated to Security Lead + Legal.
5) Technical mitigations: encrypted snapshot with a customer-specific KMS key, access via temporary role with MFA, and full audit logging (who/when/checksum).

We will also require masking of any PII (if discovered) before handing artifacts over; if this is not possible we will provide a redacted view only.

If you can send a quick one-paragraph justification and the exact selectors, I can triage and approve today.

— Irene Choi
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-18T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment latency incident - requesting recent logs

Irene — we can produce a timeboxed encrypted snapshot from the serving nodes and the prefix-level KV-cache metadata for the requested window. Plan:
- Create s3://redwood-exceptions/finhealth/INF-4821-20271017 snapshot object (server-side AES256 + customer KMS wrap).
- Limit contents to logs (payment service), KV-cache metadata keys (no raw model weights), and request/response metadata tied to the tenant id fh-8371.
- Run an automated scrub for obvious PII (card tokens, SSNs) and mark any items requiring manual review.
- Provision an ephemeral IAM role (expiration 48h) for samuel.nguyen@finhealth.com and one backup principal (security@finhealth.com).
- Produce a checksum and an audit event when object is created and when downloaded.

I'll attach the internal playbook we use for these snapshots — it includes scrub heuristics and the ACL template. We can begin this afternoon after Security confirms scope.

Attachments: snapshot_playbook.md

— Markus Klein
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-18T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment latency incident - requesting recent logs

Quick note from GTM: FinHealth is in a paid pilot and this triage directly impacts their go/no-go decision. They need the artifacts to unblock their verification tests — request we default to 48h as Irene suggested and get Security sign-off ASAP.

I'll confirm the requestor principals and get FinHealth to send a one-line justification directly to Irene to speed approval. Monica, can you coordinate the access timing?

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment latency incident - requesting recent logs

All — finalizing:

I approve a scoped, timeboxed residency exception for FinHealth (tenant id fh-8371) covering 2027-10-17T02:50:00Z–2027-10-17T04:00:00Z. Conditions:
- Scope limited to payment service logs + KV-cache metadata selectors for fh-8371 only.
- Retention window: 48 hours from snapshot creation. No automatic extensions without Security Lead sign-off.
- Delivery: encrypted S3 object (customer KMS wrap). Temporary IAM role for samuel.nguyen@finhealth.com and security@finhealth.com, expiration 48h.
- Full audit logging and checksum published to INF-4821.
- Any PII discovered must be redacted before handing artifacts to external principals; otherwise provide redacted extracts only.
- Monica, please confirm the delivery time and ensure FinHealth sends the one-paragraph justification to Irene so we have an external record.

Attachments: approvals/20271019-fh-exception-signed.pdf

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. Markus — please proceed with the snapshot and tag INF-4821 in the creation event. Irene — if you need anything further to record the exception formally, flag it here and I'll escalate to Legal.

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
